title: Kissed Spicy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A tangy and adventurous Tunisian dish featuring lamb and strong white bread flour, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, high in protein and perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the flour and stir to coat the lamb, cooking for 1 minute
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper, stirring to combine
Add the chicken broth and diced tomatoes, stirring to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Serve hot over strong white bread
